title: On the Number of Generalized Cospectral Mates of Graphs
authors: M. Raza · O. U. Ahmad · M. Shabbir · W. Abbas  ·  LUMS & UT Dallas
desc: Upper bound on cospectral multiplicity via the Smith Normal Form of the walk matrix — a quantitative arithmetic criterion extending beyond binary DGS classification.

title: PMI Sequence — An Erdős-Szekeres Type Result
desc: Tight asymptotic bounds Θ((d!·n)<sup>1/d</sup>) on the longest pairwise monotone increasing sequence in n-point subsets of ℤ<sub>≥0</sub><sup>d</sup>.

title: Cospectral Mates — Ring-Theoretic Extension
authors: M. Raza · O. U. Ahmad · M. Shabbir · W. Abbas
desc: Ring-theoretic view of walk-matrix arithmetic constraints. The elementary divisors of W(G) over ℤ control the multiplicity of generalized cospectral mates.

title: Reconstructability vs. Godsil-McKay Switching
desc: Can Godsil-McKay switching produce reconstruction counterexamples? Partial result: degree-altering switchings are always deck-distinguishable.
